extracted.name: Banana Bread
extracted.description: My son super loves bananas so we always have them in the pantry. To avoid wastage of over-riped bananas, I decided to make one of my favorite.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit)
Add eggs and crushed bananas. Combine well.
Sift together, flour, soda and salt. Add vanilla. Do not over mix.
